Exercise data and images come from free-exercise-db by yuhonas (github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db), released into the public domain under the Unlicense. The grouping into exercises and variants, the Spanish translations and the additional exercises are by the Haltera authors.

Nutrient values of the bundled generic foods come from USDA FoodData Central (fdc.nal.usda.gov: Foundation Foods and SR Legacy), released into the public domain under CC0 1.0. Barcode lookups use Open Food Facts (world.openfoodfacts.org), available under the Open Database License (ODbL 1.0) with contents under the Database Contents License (DbCL 1.0); products found are cached on the device. The selection of foods, their names in English and Spanish and the serving sizes are by the Haltera authors.

This stores your workouts, routines, body weight, meals, notes and nutrition profile in a private cloud space only you can open. You can turn it off and delete it at any time in Settings → Account.
Your cloud copy is now optional

Your logbook is already backed up and keeps syncing; nothing was deleted. From now on the cloud copy is a choice: you can turn it off, and delete your cloud data, in Settings → Account → Back up to the cloud.
